Here's a brief overview:

3rd Party Insurance
- Covers damages to other people or property in an accident
- Mandatory in most countries
- Doesn't cover damages to your own vehicle

Comprehensive Insurance
- Covers damages to your own vehicle (own damage cover)
- Covers damages to other people or property (third-party liability)
- Optional, but provides more extensive coverage

Comprehensive insurance offers broader protection, but it's typically more expensive than third-party insurance.
